name: NextEnergy Foundation
program: NextEnergy Foundation project funding (clean energy, water and livelihoods; partner charities)
collect_note: NEF has no calls listing (it takes project ideas through a standing short form and funds partner charities), so the twice-daily run reads the WordPress API behind its News section (post type 'update') and keeps only items whose title announces open applications, a call or a request for proposals; they wait as candidates. All 16 current news items are project progress reports, so zero items is expected until NEF announces a call; the filter was tested only against synthetic call-style titles because NEF has no past call.

zero_reason.quote: Submit a short form to help us determine if your project aligns with NextEnergy Foundation’s commitment to clean energy and sustainable development.

evidence: 2026-11-12: endpoint_recon verdict html_ok (WordPress/Elementor); /feed/ HTTP 200 with 0 items; sitemap.xml 11 urls, no calls section; /wp-json/wp/v2/types lists post types update, projects, team, company, none of them calls; /wp-json/wp/v2/update?per_page=20 returns 16 progress-report posts (latest 2026-06-25), none a call; /news/ renders the same posts as e-loop-item buttons; /contact-us/ links only a standing project short form (jet-form-builder, not submitted).
